record.question: Choose the option which is closest in meaning to profane.
record.explanation: Answer D: desecrate. “Profane” as a verb means treat something sacred with irreverence or desecrate. Independent check: To profane something sacred is to treat it irreverently or desecrate it. Reference: https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/profane; https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/profane. Verified worked solution, unofficial.
